CommonLifecycleModel.description:
Lifecycle phases for common models.

Maps phase names to phase configurations. Phase names follow the pattern ``{command}_{action}_{suffix}``, e.g. ``deploy_plan_before``, ``deploy_provision``, ``deploy_destroy_after``, ``config_clear``. This is an open map (any phase name is allowed) rather than a fixed set of fields, since each kind and provisioner type defines its own set of supported phases.

CommonLifecyclePhaseModel.description: Lifecycle phase configuration: a description plus its scripts.

scripts.description: Scripts to run. Each entry is a path relative to the solution root, with one of the extensions bash, go, js, mjs, ps1, py, sh, or an object with `file`, `scope`, `priority` and `target`.

ModuleCheckModel.description: Model for a module health check configuration.

target.description: Target resource for the health check

type.description: Type of health check (e.g., http, tcp, command)

retries.description: Number of retries before marking as unhealthy

endpoint.description: Endpoint URL for HTTP-type health checks

command.description: Command to run for 'command' type health checks

ModuleEndpointModel.description: Model for a module endpoint configuration.

url.description: URL or address of the endpoint

protocol.description: Protocol for the endpoint (e.g., tcp, udp)

ModuleFileModel.description:
A file or glob to copy unchanged into the module's build output directory. Accepted and validated, but strata does not copy these files yet.

Rules:
- A glob in `source` requires `target` to be a directory, written with a trailing `/`.
- `source` and `target` must be relative: no leading `/` and no `..` (a `source` may start with `@<remote>/`).

source.description: Source file path or glob pattern. Supports @repo/ cross-repository references. Examples: 'services/traefik/traefik.yaml', '@infra/configs/*', 'scripts/**/*.sh'

target.description: Relative destination path inside the module's build output directory. Use a trailing '/' to indicate a directory (required when source is a glob). Examples: 'traefik.yaml', 'config/', 'conf.d/'

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the module

ModuleMountModel.description:
A mount for a module or one of its services. For Compose use `volume_ref` (a named volume); for Kubernetes use `storage_class` to request a PersistentVolumeClaim.

Rules:
- `volume_ref` and `storage_class` are mutually exclusive.
- `storage_size` is required when `storage_class` is set.

type.description: Type of the mount (e.g., volume, bind)

source_path.description: Source path of the mount (bind mount host path)

volume_ref.description: Name of the Compose named volume to mount. Mutually exclusive with `storage_class`.

storage_class.description: Kubernetes StorageClass name (for example `standard`). A Helm module then gets a `persistence` entry in its values with the class, `access_mode` and `storage_size`. Mutually exclusive with `volume_ref`.

storage_size.description: PVC storage size (e.g. '10Gi'). Required when storage_class is set.

ModuleServiceEnvironmentModel.description: One environment variable of a service. `value` is a literal, or contains value tokens such as `${var:KEY}`, `${secret:KEY}` or `${feature:KEY}`, resolved at build or deploy time.

value.description: Literal value, or a string containing '${var:KEY}'/'${secret:KEY}'/'${feature:KEY}' tokens.

ModuleServiceModel.description:
One container (or sub-chart component) of a module. For Compose each service becomes a Compose service; for Helm each becomes a section of the chart's values.

Service names are prefixed with the module name (service `redis` of module `authentik` becomes `authentik-redis`), except when a service has the same name as its module.

Rules:
- `image` and `artifact` are mutually exclusive: use one or the other.

image.description: Container image and tag (e.g. 'postgres:16-alpine'). Omit for Helm charts that define their own image. Mutually exclusive with `artifact`.

artifact.description: Name of an Artifact document that supplies this service's image (its `image_name` and `image_tag`; a Version document can pin it). Mutually exclusive with `image`: use `image` for a literal, unpinned string. For a Helm module it is a declaration only: write it into the chart's values with an `${artifact:NAME.FIELD}` token in `configuration`.

command.description: Override the container entrypoint or command, for example `[worker]`. Used for Compose; Helm ignores it.

restart.description: Compose restart policy (e.g. 'unless-stopped'). Ignored by helm/argocd.

environment.description: Environment variables for this service, used by both Compose and Helm. Use `${secret:KEY}`, `${var:KEY}` or `${feature:KEY}` tokens to keep secrets out of plaintext.

ports.description: Port mappings as `host:container`, for example `8080:80`. Used for Compose; Helm and Argo CD expose ports through Kubernetes Services.

mounts.description:
Volume and bind mounts. Use `volume_ref` for Compose named volumes and `storage_class` for Kubernetes persistent volume claims.

Rules:
- `volume_ref` and `storage_class` are mutually exclusive.
- `storage_size` is required when `storage_class` is set.

depends_on.description: Services that must start first. Use short names for services of this module (for example `redis`), and `@module/service` (or `@module` when the service has the module's name) for another module in the same namespace. Names of this module's services are checked when the document is loaded, cross-module names at build time. Used for Compose; Helm ignores it.

healthcheck.description: Health check for this service, rendered as a Compose healthcheck. Helm modules do not use it.

configuration.description: Extra settings merged verbatim into the output: into the service entry for Compose, and into this service's section of the chart values for Helm.

ModuleSpecModel.description:
What a module deploys and how: its `source`, a deployer `type`, and either `services` (containers or sub-charts) or, for a single service, `mounts`, `checks` and `endpoints`. A namespace references it.

Rules:
- Service names must be unique within the module.
- `compose_file` and `services` are mutually exclusive.
- Every short name in `services[].depends_on` must be a service of this module; entries starting with `@` are only syntax-checked here and resolved at build time.
- `type` may not be a known infrastructure tool. The deployers are argocd, compose, helm, script; any other name is treated as a custom plugin.

source.description:
Where the module's code comes from: a git path or a Helm chart.

Rules:
- Exactly one mode is used: git-based (`source_path`) or chart-based (`chart_name`), never both and never neither.
- A chart-based source needs exactly one of `remote` or `chart_repository`.
- `chart_repository` and `chart_version` are only valid for chart-based sources.
- `source_path` and `target_path` must be relative paths without `..`.

type.description: Deployer for this module: `helm`, `compose`, `argocd` or `script`, or a custom provisioner plugin name. Required to render the module. Infrastructure tools such as `terraform`, `ansible` and `bicep` are rejected.

lifecycle.description: Hook scripts per phase name. Accepted and validated, but strata does not run lifecycle hooks yet.

mounts.description:
Mounts for a single-service module, passed to Terraform as `strata.modules.<name>.properties.mounts`. Compose and Helm output is generated from `services` instead.

Rules:
- `volume_ref` and `storage_class` are mutually exclusive.
- `storage_size` is required when `storage_class` is set.

checks.description: Health checks for a single-service module, passed to Terraform as `strata.modules.<name>.properties.checks`. Compose and Helm output is generated from `services` instead.

endpoints.description: Endpoints for a single-service module, passed to Terraform as `strata.modules.<name>.properties.endpoints`. Compose and Helm output is generated from `services` instead.

configuration.description: Free-form settings. For a Helm module they are merged into the chart's `values.yaml`, and a key that a local chart does not declare gives a warning. They are also passed to Terraform as `strata.modules.<name>.configuration`. Strata does not validate the keys itself: add an `attributeconfig` with `target.kind: module` and `target.block: configuration` to do so.

custom.description: Free-form values for your own scripts and Terraform code, passed to Terraform as `strata.modules.<name>.custom`. Strata does not interpret them. Environment variables belong in `services[].environment`.

default_labels.description: Baseline labels for this module, passed to Terraform as `strata.modules.<name>.default_labels`. Strata does not add them to the Helm or Compose output itself.

custom_labels.description: Additional labels on top of `default_labels`, passed to Terraform the same way.

services.description:
Containers (Compose) or sub-chart sections (Helm) that make up this module. Without it the module uses the single-service shape (`mounts`, `checks`, `endpoints`).

Rules:
- `image` and `artifact` are mutually exclusive: use one or the other.

compose_file.description: Path to an existing docker-compose file (`@<remote>/path` or solution-relative) to use instead of `services`. Not implemented yet: rendering fails with a message to use `services`.

files.description:
Extra files to copy into the module's build output. Accepted and validated, but strata does not copy them yet.

Rules:
- A glob in `source` requires `target` to be a directory, written with a trailing `/`.
- `source` and `target` must be relative: no leading `/` and no `..` (a `source` may start with `@<remote>/`).

release_name.description: Helm release name or Argo CD application name. Defaults to the name of the module reference in the namespace. For `type: helm`, the name actually used (this field or the default) must be a valid Helm release name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending with a letter or digit, at most 53 characters. `strata validate` reports any other as an error, and two module references in one workspace that install the same release into the same Kubernetes namespace. Value tokens are not resolved here.

kubernetes_namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace to deploy this module into. Defaults to the strata namespace name when not set. For `type: helm`, the name actually used must be a valid Kubernetes namespace: lowercase letters, digits and '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit, at most 63 characters. Strata namespace names may contain '_', so set this field when the strata namespace name is not a valid Kubernetes one. Value tokens are not resolved here.

ScriptPathModel.description: Individual script with scope and execution metadata.

scope.description: Execution scope - determines how many times the script runs (e.g. deployment, environment, workspace, provider, resource, module, namespace)

priority.description: Execution order within scope (lower runs first)

SourceModel.description:
Where the code of a module or provisioner comes from. Pick one mode:

- Git-based: `source_path`, optionally with `remote`. Omit `remote` for this solution's own repository. Used for Terraform modules, local charts and similar.
- Chart-based: `chart_name` with exactly one of `remote` (a remote from the solution manifest) or `chart_repository` (an inline URL). Used for Helm and Argo CD charts.

Rules:
- Exactly one mode is used: git-based (`source_path`) or chart-based (`chart_name`), never both and never neither.
- A chart-based source needs exactly one of `remote` or `chart_repository`.
- `chart_repository` and `chart_version` are only valid for chart-based sources.
- `source_path` and `target_path` must be relative paths without `..`.

remote.description: Name of a remote declared in the solution manifest's spec.remotes (strata.yaml). The remote owns the URL, the git/OCI ref and the credentials; this only selects which one to take from. Required for a git-based source with credentials/a pinned ref; for a chart-based source, either this or `chart_repository` is required (mutually exclusive) — use `remote` when the registry is shared across modules or needs credentials, `chart_repository` otherwise. Omitting both on a git-based source means this solution's own repository.

source_path.description: Path to the source artifacts within the repository (relative path)

target_path.description: Target path where artifacts should be built/deployed (relative to build/deploy directory)

chart_name.description: Helm chart name (e.g. 'authentik'). Selects chart-based mode; requires exactly one of `remote`/`chart_repository`.

chart_version.description: Helm chart version (e.g. '2024.12.0'). Omit to use latest. Only valid in chart-based mode. Unlike a git ref, this is NOT remote identity — a chart index legitimately serves many versions, so picking one is selection and belongs here rather than on the remote.

chart_repository.description: Inline Helm chart repository URL or OCI reference (for example `https://charts.goauthentik.io` or `oci://ghcr.io/org/charts`), for a chart used by exactly one module that needs no credentials. Only valid in chart-based mode and mutually exclusive with `remote`. Use `remote` once the registry is shared by several modules or needs credentials. The URL is not checked against the solution manifest, so a typo only shows up when Helm fails to add the repository.

description: A deployable workload: a Helm chart, Docker Compose services, an Argo CD application or a script, with its source and settings. Create one per workload and reference it from a namespace's `modules` (or a topology component's `modules`).

spec.description:
Module specification (source, lifecycle, services, configuration)

Rules:
- Service names must be unique within the module.
- `compose_file` and `services` are mutually exclusive.
- Every short name in `services[].depends_on` must be a service of this module; entries starting with `@` are only syntax-checked here and resolved at build time.
- `type` may not be a known infrastructure tool. The deployers are argocd, compose, helm, script; any other name is treated as a custom plugin.
